caption: The drawing depicts a square panel with a three-dimensional effect, bordered by a thick brown outline with a narrower beige edge on the left and top sides to create the illusion of depth. The interior of the panel contains an ornate, symmetrical ornamental design centered within a blue oval shape. Inside the blue oval, a beige, stylized floral or leaf motif rises vertically and branches outward, ending in curved shapes. Additional beige decorative elements are positioned around the oval, interspersed with sections of the blue background. Three white symmetrical shapes highlight the top, bottom, and sides of the motif inside the blue oval. The surrounding background outside the blue oval is filled with a solid brown color, accented with lighter beige decorative shapes and vertical brown bands on both outer edges. The artist's signature “W. W. JENNINGS” is visible in the lower right corner of the panel. The rest of the sheet surrounding the central design is left plain and uncolored.
title: Floor Tile
